name: verify-integrate
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when the loop adopts a non-git VCS backend, or a model-backed verify/integrate policy replaces the deterministic gh-based gates, or when the Verdict / IntegrationResult / ReviewVerdict schemas reach a breaking major version.
spec_change_reason: INTEGRATE merge sink is MERGE-QUEUE-AWARE: detect repository.mergeQueue(branch) and, when a queue exists, run `gh pr merge <pr> --auto` with NO method flag and NO --delete-branch (a queue branch REJECTS a method flag); no-queue keeps immediate `--merge --delete-branch` with `--auto --merge` fallback; capture gh stderr into errors (never a bare exit-1)
spec_no_change_reason: spec+contract merge-queue-aware changes already committed on this branch (commit 3d86f4a); no further uncommitted spec diff this step
